instruction: Fill the curved rectangular trash can with the bottles the yellow plastic bottle, the bottle with blue highlights, and the bottle with red screw cap.

source.instruction: Fill the curved rectangular trash can with the bottles the yellow plastic bottle, the bottle with blue highlights, and the bottle with red screw cap.

arm_note: ARM CHOICE in this demonstration: the LEFT arm grasped the dustbin, which was at x = -45 (left half of the table); the RIGHT arm grasped the dustbin, which was at x = -45 (left half of the table). The arm was chosen by the object's x position (x < 0 -> LEFT arm, x > 0 -> RIGHT arm; each arm reaches only ~15 cm past the centre line). In YOUR scene the objects may be on the other side: choose the arm from your own object positions, not from the demonstration.
